name: westland
description: Westland organizational plugin — safety hooks, house-style references, bug-report capture, and meeting-transcript reading. Install first; required dependency of domain plugins. Contains the Westland Project Files PreToolUse hook (modify-prompt on existing files; .xer in-place changes/deletes denied; .html/.md/.json allowlisted), plus the westland-house-style, westland-bug-report (Procore-gated bug capture to Supabase), and read-meeting-transcript (M365 Teams transcript reader) skills.
